ValidationRule.description: Approval code is required when discount is over 20% and must be AP-<DDD>-<2 letter stage initials> where DDD is the close day-of-year.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NULLVALUE(Discount_Pct__c, 0) > 0.2, ISBLANK(Approval_Code__c)), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Approval_Code__c)), OR(NOT(REGEX(Approval_Code__c, 'AP-[0-9]{3}-[A-Z]{2}')), VALUE(MID(Approval_Code__c, 4, 3)) <> DAYOFYEAR(CloseDate), RIGHT(Approval_Code__c, 2) <> UPPER(LEFT(TEXT(StageName), 2)))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approval Code is missing or malformed for this discount level.
